This file is deliberately absent from frontx-template.json's ownershipBoundaries, so `frontx add` never copies it into a seeded project and this template claims ownership of no root package.json anywhere. The MFE packages below pin their @gears-frontx dependencies to exact published versions, which is what a seeded project installs. Inside this monorepo those pins would fetch registry tarballs, so local edits to packages/* and template-shell/packages/* would be invisible; the overrides here redirect each pinned name to its local source instead. Because they redirect rather than re-declare, the installed versions still satisfy the pins and `npm ls` stays clean. Keep this file free of version numbers: every entry below is a path or a glob, so the pins remain the single place a version is written down.
